what_this_is: Authorization for the one, single holdout run -- typed and pinned BEFORE any computation against the holdout happens. make_phase3_run.py refuses to run without it.
what_this_is_not: Not a result, not a retroactive declaration, and not itself a computation. It authorizes exactly one future run of make_phase3_run.py, pinned to the exact code and lock that exist right now.
attestation_text: I authorize the one, single holdout run against HYP-04's frozen 57-event holdout set. I understand this cannot be undone or repeated: whatever the result, it will be reported as computed, and no future run against this holdout will be made to look for a better one.
how_it_is_used: make_phase3_run.py verifies: exactly one authorization exists, declared is true, consumed is false, pinned_commit_sha matches HEAD, and pinned_phase2_lock_sha256 matches the lock on disk. It marks this consumed the instant a real run succeeds.
